annotations.title: Etapa: ask your companion about your guide

description: Asks the rider's Etapa companion (the AI that guides them, e.g. Matteo or Clara) anything about their riding and their guide: what a session is for, a missed ride, how hard to go, feeling tired or sore, what to eat, moving their week around. The companion knows their guide, this week, their goal and what they've said in the app; the conversation carries on in the app. When it suggests a change to the guide, ask the rider, and only on a yes call `etapa_apply_change`. If the answer is still coming, call it again with no question.

question.description: The rider's message, in their words. Leave out only to collect an answer still coming.

name: etapa_ask_companion
